description: @dimarborda/docx-editor (Word .docx editor for the browser) and @dimarborda/xlsx-editor (Excel .xlsx editor for the browser plus headless engine for Node.js): lossless Rust + WebAssembly engines with APIs built for AI agents.
rules: Read the package's AGENTS.md first: node_modules/@dimarborda/docx-editor/AGENTS.md or node_modules/@dimarborda/xlsx-editor/AGENTS.md. Exact signatures are in src/index.d.ts and src/engine.d.ts.
Edit documents through the API, never by unzipping or rewriting the OOXML: the engines save losslessly and every API edit is one undo step.
docx-editor is browser only and its container needs a height. Create it with await DocxEditor.create(el) inside useEffect in React/Next.js; importing is SSR-safe.
docx-editor positions are paragraph indexes that shift after edits: re-read structure(), tables() or markers() after each change; prefer section keys and markers.
Fill templates with replaceVariables() and fillMarker() (docx) or wb.fillTemplate() (xlsx): {{KEY}} and {key} are fields, [...] or [Complete: hint] is pending content.
xlsx-editor: use @dimarborda/xlsx-editor/engine in Node.js. Rows and column numbers are 1-based like Excel, sheet indexes are 0-based; ranges are A1 strings.
xlsx-editor: write formulas in English syntax ({ formula: '=SUM(A1:A3)' }), numbers as numbers and dates as Date in UTC (new Date(Date.UTC(y, m, d))).
xlsx-editor: summarize a sheet with wb.areas() and wb.area(target) (columns, types, totals, markdown) instead of reading every cell.
xlsx-editor in the browser: call editor.workbook.checkpoint() before changing editor.workbook from code and editor.reload() after.
Operations that would break merged cells, tables, filters or array formulas throw and change nothing: catch the error and report its message.
With a Content-Security-Policy in production, script-src needs 'wasm-unsafe-eval' for both packages.
